**Recommended one-shot formulation:**

- **Ethanol:** **45.0 v/v%**
- **SDS:** **0.75 w/v%**

**Rationale:** The best valid result so far was around `34.56% ethanol / 0.75% SDS → 68.108°`. Since the contact angle is still ~3° too high, increasing ethanol while keeping SDS near the best-performing moderate-high level is the most plausible one-shot move toward 65°. I would choose **45% ethanol / 0.75% SDS** rather than maxing both components, because SDS = 1.0% has not consistently outperformed ~0.75%, and 45% ethanol gives a strong push downward while staying safely inside the corrected feasible ethanol range.
